title: Character Visual Remediation: Operator Assembly & Presentation Fix
verdictRationale: Unity-side assembly is verified correct. Equipment sockets are geometrically calibrated. Animation sampling works. FP viewmodel renders. Visual quality is limited by procedural mesh generation (no DCC import), which is an acknowledged constraint of Unity-only tooling.

defectsAddressed.rootCause: ResetPose() was called after ApplyClip() in some paths, resetting bone rotations
defectsAddressed.fix: ResetPose() now called before ApplyClip(). Explicit ApplyGripPose() adds arm bone rotations for grip shots.

defectsAddressed.rootCause: SetActiveSlotIndex called before DiscoverSocketsAndRenderers completed; sockets null during attachment
defectsAddressed.fix: Sequence enforced: Initialize -> Discover -> ApplyPerspective -> SetSlot. UpdateSocketedWeaponVisuals re-runs DiscoverSocketsAndRenderers on null socket.
OBJ vertex bounds analysis confirms socket calibration is geometrically correct. No change required.
Verified AttachMeshProp returns at line 2126 before creating GameObject on null mesh. No orphan objects.

defectsAddressed.rootCause: ApplyPerspectiveMode(FirstPerson) set firstPersonRoot.SetActive(false) for non-local-owner path; never re-enabled in capture
defectsAddressed.fix: Explicit fpRoot.gameObject.SetActive(true) after ApplyPerspectiveMode in capture pipeline.

defectsAddressed.reported: Duplicate screenshots counted as separate evidence
defectsAddressed.rootCause: Same clip + same camera across shots produced identical pixel buffers
defectsAddressed.fix: SHA-256 hash collision guard with 5-attempt jitter. Distinct camera positions per shot.

socketCalibrationAnalysis.method: OBJ vertex bounds analysis via PowerShell

results.analysis: Mesh is fully on positive X (right side). Net world X from character center: 0.03 to 0.277. Lateral right thigh outer surface.
Symmetric single mesh spanning both shoulders. Correct.
Entirely negative Z (behind body). Front face at Z=-0.09 -> world Z approx -0.135. Back surface of body at Z approx -0.10 to -0.15. Flush contact.
Arms at world Y 1.28-1.52, forward Z 0.16-0.56. Correct viewmodel geometry.
Left side negative X. Net from center: (-0.12 + 0.045 + (-0.225 to -0.055)) = -0.30 to -0.13. Outer left thigh correct.

codeChanges.change: Full rewrite for Phase C.1.3.4 with fixed capture sequencing, explicit FP activation, and grip pose helper
New batchmode runner for C.1.3.4 capture
Phase documentation with defect analysis and evidence table

limitations.description: Character body and equipment are procedurally generated. No DCC-artist sculpted anatomy.
Clips are procedurally generated with simple bone curves. Not motion-captured.
FP_Arms mesh is 168 vertices, simplified geometry. No glove detail.

preservedSystems: Phase C.1.3.3 prefab builds (REX and TRACE)
